newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish Jan c/a up, foreign trade down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish Jan c/a up, foreign trade down.

text.p: Thirteen economists polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Friday forecast on average a swing back into surplus for Denmark's current account and a fall in the foreign trade surplus for January 1997.
The panel foresaw an average 4.4 billion crown current account surplus for January, compared with December 1996's 2.3 billion crown shortfall, with estimates ranging from 3.5 to 5.5 billion crowns.

On foreign trade, excluding ships, for January, the analysts forecast an average 2.5 billion crown surplus, a fall from December's 3.2 billion crown surplus, with estimates in the 2.0-2.8 billion crown range.
The national statistics office releases the Danish January current account and foreign trade data on April 23 at 0730 gmt.
